title: Y ON A TRADE OFFER OPENS NOTHING ELSE
why: Found by the whole-game bug hunt of 2026-10-08. In co-op in the Undercroft, when one player offers an item, the other can take it with T or with Y on the controller. Standing at the lift, the shop counter or the Mainframe, the same Y press also worked the station, so the PARTY window, HIRE or the RACKS tab opened over the trade he had just accepted. On the keyboard T was already spent on the offer. Y is now spent on the offer too: the station waits until Y is let go, and with no offer waiting Y works the station as before.
now: Taking a trade offer with Y on the controller no longer opens the station window behind it.
